messages:
anjali: Quick sync: I opened PR 6710 to split troubleshooting into smaller pages. Focus this thread on the 429 + timeout examples we need.

ben: Saw it. We need a tiny matrix: when to do client-side timeout, when to do server retry, and when to do context trim. Ops wants a Go snippet for parsing Retry-After.

owen: Also include a JS fetch example showing abort controller + UI fallback. Many callers use fetch directly.

anjali: Agreed. Proposed headings: Handling 429s, Client timeouts, Server retry patterns, Context trim fallback. Short anchors like #context-trim.

marco: For the context-trim section please include a short algorithm: (1) try trimming system prompt, (2) drop less-relevant messages, (3) fallback to a cheaper model. Keep example pseudocode small.

anjali: will add. sample pseudo-code to include:

```
// trim algorithm (pseudo)
if token_count(prompt) > budget:
  prompt = drop_low_score_messages(prompt_history, keep=3)
  if token_count(prompt) > budget:
    prompt = shorten_system_instructions(prompt)
```

ben: For 429s: show both honoring Retry-After header and exponential jitter if header missing. Include a one-liner telemetry query to measure 429s / minute.

own: I'll draft the Go snippet for Retry-After parsing. Quick sketch:

```go
resp, err := client.Generate(ctx, req)
if err != nil && isRateLimit(err) {
  ra := resp.Header.Get("Retry-After")
  if secs := parseRetryAfter(ra); secs > 0 {
    time.Sleep(time.Duration(secs) * time.Second)
  } else {
    time.Sleep(time.Duration(randExpBackoff()) * time.Millisecond)
  }
  // fallback: trim prompt or route to cheaper model
}
```

anjali: Nice. Please add a comment about malformed headers returning 0 and recommending backoff.

marco: For SDK snippets: the Python example currently blocks on repeated retries. Let's show an asyncio.wait_for approach + built-in retry helper example.

ben: Also call out that retries should only be used for idempotent requests; generation with user transactions may need careful handling.

docs-bot: docs CI started for PR 6710: linkcheck ok, snippet-lint flagged missing language on one code block at line 78.

anjali: I'll fix markup. Also note: we need a tiny integration test that verifies trimmed prompt still returns non-empty summary to avoid accidental deletes. Who can add?

own: I can add a smoke test in the snippet harness. Will assert length > 20 tokens.

marco: Editorial: prefer the term "context trim" (short) and define it first use. Keep headings consistent across pages.

anjali: Done. Pushed fixes. docs-bot: re-run?

docs-bot: snippet-lint passed; all checks green.

ben: Quick final: add a 1-sentence blurb at top about UX: prefer fast failure with graceful UI for interactive apps.

anjali: added marketing-friendly 2-line blurb too. Merge timeline? EOD today would be ideal.

marco: +1. I can review final markdown in 30m.

own: merging after Marco's review.

anjali: thanks all 44d will follow up to update internal runbook redirects. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
